blob.description: The content key of the bytes these rows describe

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed, each under one fixed synthetic file name: `ts` (`.ts`, `.mts`, `.cts`, not a declaration file) as `vat.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `dts` (every name TypeScript's isDeclarationFileName accepts) as `vat.d.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `tsx` (`.tsx`) as `vat.tsx`, ScriptKind TSX; `js` (`.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`) as `vat.js`, ScriptKind JS

import.description: The `ts__imports` ordinal of the reference that creates the binding

seq.description: 0-based position among the reference's bindings, in source order

imported.description: The exported name bound: a name, `default`, or `*` for a namespace import, `import x = require()` and a whole-module `const x = require()`

local.description: The local name the binding creates

typeOnly.description: Whether the binding is type-only, at statement level or by an inline `type`

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break; at the local name token
